notes: WoW: Forever moved the healing potions to First Aid (seen in this client's First Aid window on 2026-11-26: Minor, Lesser, plain and Greater Healing Potion, made with spices and a vial), so the Classic route's healing potion steps (1-140, 155-185, 215-230, 285-300; Superior and Major are taken to have moved with the rest, not seen yet) are left out. No Forever replacement is known, so none is guessed: The Mentor fills those ranks from your own recipes, by the colour the game gives them. Icy Veins (https://www.icy-veins.com/wow-classic/classic-alchemy-profession-guide) returned HTTP 403 / a Cloudflare bot check to both WebFetch and the browser, so no Icy Veins alternatives were recorded. Wowhead offers no alternative recipes on its 1-300 path. The guide links only spell IDs for its steps; product item IDs, reagent counts per craft and learnAt come from Wowhead's own spell pages for those spell IDs (g_spells data: creates/reagents/learnedat), and match the guide's material totals. 285-300 crafts is '~18' in the guide. The spell pages carry no source flag for Minor Healing Potion, Philosophers' Stone, Superior Mana Potion and Major Healing Potion; they are recorded as trainer because the guide gives no recipe/vendor source for them. Vials (3371, 3372, 8925) are vendor-sold.
